name: both
whatItDemonstrates: A 10x10 grid of 100 numbered cells overflowing in both axes, rendered with both a vertical (default) and an explicit horizontal scrollbar plus a Corner part so the two scrollbars do not intersect.
stateManaged: none — no props or state; scrolling is native via the viewport
nonTrivialInteractions: Two Scrollbar siblings: the first uses the default vertical orientation and the second passes orientation="horizontal"
Orientation-conditional scrollbar sizing driven by data-[orientation=vertical]/data-[orientation=horizontal] attributes (w-4 vs h-4) in Tailwind / [data-orientation] rules in the CSS module
ScrollArea.Corner rendered as a sibling of the scrollbars to fill their intersection

Scrollbar fades in only while hovered or scrolling: opacity 0 / pointer-events none by default, toggled by data-hovering and data-scrolling attributes, with data-scrolling also forcing transition duration to 0

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: The minimal vertical scroll area: two paragraphs of long text in a fixed-height root with a single default-orientation scrollbar that fades in on hover or scroll.
stateManaged: none — no props or state; scrolling is native via the viewport
nonTrivialInteractions: Scrollbar visibility tied to data-hovering/data-scrolling attributes: hidden (opacity 0, pointer-events none) until hovered or scrolled, with data-scrolling forcing transition-duration 0 so it appears instantly while scrolling
Focus-visible outline styled directly on the Viewport (outline-2 with negative offset)

name: scroll-fade
whatItDemonstrates: A gradient scroll fade: a CSS mask-image on the Viewport driven by the component's --scroll-area-overflow-y-start / --scroll-area-overflow-y-end CSS variables so content gradually fades at the top/bottom edges as the user scrolls away from them (fade width capped at 40px, with a 40px SSR fallback on the end-side var()).
stateManaged: none — no props or state; the fade is purely CSS-variable-driven from the Viewport's live scroll metrics
nonTrivialInteractions: mask-image (Tailwind arbitrary mask-linear-[...] utility / CSS module mask-image) using min(40px, var(--scroll-area-overflow-y-start)) and min(40px, var(--scroll-area-overflow-y-end, 40px)) with mask-repeat: no-repeat
SSR fallback: the end-side var() carries a 40px fallback so the mask is visible before the overflow variables hydrate

Focus outline moved to the Root via a :has() selector (has-[>_:first-child:focus-visible] in Tailwind, &:has(.Viewport:focus-visible) in the CSS module) because the Viewport itself sets outline: none under the mask
Same data-hovering/data-scrolling scrollbar fade behavior as the hero demo, with an added 150ms duration for the resting transition
